info.name: Workora Backend API
info.description: Implemented backend controller routes, organized by service. Set baseUrl and accessToken in collection variables. Default gateway base URL: http://localhost:8080. JSON request bodies include example fields based on backend request DTOs; replace IDs, enum values, credentials, and storage keys with valid local values. Auth and health routes use noauth; other requests inherit bearer auth. Shared storage routes are included under all six mounting service prefixes: identity, organization, project, work, bug, and recruitment. Compatibility aliases are labeled. Examples are not guaranteed to satisfy cross-resource ownership or business-state preconditions.
